notes_ja: 本ledgerは運用上の調査記録である。法的許諾そのものではない。decision=allowed 以外は runtime で利用不能。推測で allowed にしない。

sources.label: trace.moe
sources.storage: Terms page states uploaded search images are deleted immediately. Preview image/video URLs expire in 300 seconds. This is operator policy, not a license for ATB to store user images.
sources.redistribution: No public license found that grants redistribution of index, previews, or match metadata in a commercial product.
sources.attribution: No production attribution contract found. API server source is MIT; MIT on self-hosted code is not a license to use the public hosted index of copyrighted works.
sources.rate_limit: Guest quota documented as 100 searches / 24 hours per IP; API key via x-trace-key raises quota. Concurrency limit; HTTP 402 when quota/concurrency exceeded. File size limit 25MB (HTTP 413).
sources.rationale_ja: 公開APIとquotaは確認できた。商用利用・再配布・SLAの許諾文は見つからず、ホスト済みindexは著作権物の指紋である。operator (help@trace.moe) の明示許諾なしに production 接続しない。

sources.label: AniList GraphQL API
sources.storage: Using the API as backup or data storage is strictly prohibited. Hoarding/mass collection is prohibited.
sources.redistribution: Mass collection prohibited. Competing anime/manga list or tracker services of the same nature are prohibited, including media data.
sources.attribution: Naming guidelines: cannot use the titles AniList/AniChart alone; unofficial naming required if those names appear.
sources.rate_limit: Documented 90 requests/minute; docs warn of a degraded 30 requests/minute cap. 429 + Retry-After. Rate-limit raises not accepted at review date.
sources.sla: No availability SLA. Docs state the API may be unavailable; severe outages may lower limits or suspend access. Announced on Discord.
sources.rationale_ja: 既存の季節データ取得用途とは別に、本Issueの認識production経路としては許可しない。商用は月$150超でライセンス要。競合する list/tracker 条項があり、本アプリの視聴管理・Tierと衝突しうるため permission-required。

sources.label: Jikan (unofficial MyAnimeList API)
sources.attribution: Docs require a disclaimer that Jikan is not affiliated with MyAnimeList.net. MAL Terms of Service still apply to usage of scraped MAL data.
sources.rate_limit: Public instance: 3 requests/second and 60 requests/minute. Daily unlimited per docs. HTTP 429. MAL may also rate-limit upstream.
sources.rationale_ja: 公式ToS URL (https://jikan.moe/terms) は 2026-08-31 に 404。商用・保存・再配布条件を推測で allowed にしない。非公式MALスクレイプであり、MAL ToS/API Agreement も未許諾のまま production 接続しない。decision=unknown。

sources.label: Official promotional videos (rights-holder / YouTube / official sites)
sources.storage: YouTube ToS (dated 2023-06-01, reviewed 2026-08-31) allows personal non-commercial viewing and embeddable player use. Downloading, reproducing, or creating an independent fingerprint index is not granted.
sources.redistribution: Not granted. Independent use of Content outside the Service requires prior written permission from YouTube and applicable rights holders.
sources.attribution: Using the Service does not grant ownership of Content. Official-site domains in the existing operational ledger remain unknown or permission-required and are not reclassified here.
sources.rate_limit: YouTube forbids automated access (robots/scrapers) except public search engines honoring robots.txt, or with prior written permission.
sources.rationale_ja: 公式PVは著作物。YouTube上の視聴・埋め込みは許されても、ダウンロードや指紋index化は書面許諾が必要。各公式サイトの個別許諾も未取得。permission-required。

sources.label: Unauthorized full-episode video/audio index
sources.rationale_ja: Issue #759/#760 の hard boundary。本編の無断収集による商用indexは禁止。実装・実行しない。
